_about: Cached reverse-image-search fixture (ADR-007). Keys are image identifiers (the bundle's meta.source_ref). Each value mirrors a live reverse-image API response so a real backend (Google Vision / TinEye) can drop in later without changing the fusion logic. Dates are ISO-8601. This lets the recycled-context flag be built and tested fully offline for the Preliminary Report.
